observations: Photo 0: engine shown still partially installed/removed from a vehicle, covered in grime and dust, intake manifold and wiring harness visible, belt and accessory bracket visible, no compressor clearly visible.
Photo 1: engine sitting on ground wrapped partly in plastic sheeting, surrounded by other used parts (transmissions, pulleys) in background, suggesting a used-parts yard.
Photo 2: top engine cover has hand-written marker 'V6' and some other faint writing, no manufacturer plate, part number, or engine code legible.
No visible air conditioning compressor unit in any photo despite seller's claim.
No wiring loom connectors, ECU, or sensor completeness confirmable from any image.
No visual confirmation of oil leaks, cracked housings, or physical damage beyond normal dirt/grime.
No start-up, compression test, or functional demonstration shown.
